zh-CN.name: 标书联合审查
zh-CN.summary: 五角色协作审查条款响应、商务报价和标书图片，并独立复核证据。
zh-CN.description: 用自然语言说明审查目标和材料；五个角色按重要问题、证据、整改建议与未决事项验收。结构化导出可选，结果需人工复核；真实标书效果尚未验证。成员默认收纳在组长下方并初始收起；用户显式选择平铺或收纳时，以用户选择为准。

en-US.name: Tender Review Team
en-US.summary: Five roles review requirements, pricing and tender images with independent evidence checks.
en-US.description: Describe goals and materials in natural language. Five roles assess important issues, evidence, actionable corrections and open questions. Structured export is optional; human review is required and real-bid effectiveness is not yet validated. Members initially appear collapsed under the supervisor; an explicit user choice of flat or nested display takes precedence.

requirements.value: Requires DesireCore 10.0.178 or newer with support for team.json memberDisplay. Stable 10.0.177 does not support this manifest field. This catalog release is published ahead of the compatible client; older clients must upgrade before installation. Full cross-platform release qualification remains pending.
